Row.Text: Across China, rapid development is transforming the nation. New infrastructure connects growing cities, factories expand their production, and ambitious construction projects reshape the landscape. Yet modernization brings choices about where the benefits of growth should be directed. China can accelerate construction and industrial development, building the foundations of greater economic strength, or place greater emphasis on improving life in its cities and ensuring that prosperity is broadly shared.
+15% Production toward Buildings in all Cities.

China's growing economic strength has brought greater influence beyond its borders. Diplomats travel between capitals, Chinese enterprises reach new markets, and partnerships connect the nation with countries across the world. With greater influence, however, comes greater responsibility. China must decide how best to secure its position in an increasingly complex international order: through deeper diplomatic relationships and cooperation, or by ensuring that its military possesses the strength necessary to defend the nation's interests.
All Military Units gain +5[icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength for 10 turns.

China stands at the threshold of a new era. Decades of development have transformed its cities, expanded its industries, and strengthened its connections with the wider world. The ambition of national rejuvenation now looks toward the future. China can concentrate its resources on scientific advancement, technological innovation, and productive strength at home, or deepen the international partnerships through which it seeks a greater role in shaping the world beyond its borders.
All Cities gain +15%[icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science and +15%[icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production.
Gain +1[icon:ATTRIBUTE_POLITICAL] Political Attribute Point. When undertaking [icon:ENDEAVOR] Endeavors, gain +20%[icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence.
